visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow, Redfin, and every Bend brokerage at the neighborhood grain. First screen is this neighborhood's Stage (Imagine or geo-strict library still of the place, never a street grid) then a Field of its houses on the fold. Inventory is a Field caption with the one supply sentence, never a 30-tile hero. Daily life (schools, parks) only when the library has rows.
note: PUBLIC_UI.md §3 Neighborhood, amended 2026-08-29 to match the city restyle: first screen is existing V3Stage when a place-owned Imagine or library still exists, then one Field of this neighborhood's houses. No owned still → Field only, and the Field owns the H1. The H1 is `${neighborhoodName} homes for sale` on Stage when Stage mounts. The 30-tile Instrument stack is retired. Order is Breadcrumb (on-media when Stage mounts), V3Stage, NeighborhoodHomesField (map plus list, one set, count plus verdict as caption), NeighborhoodAlertsSheet (one email ask after homes), Ledger (Latest market activity, under the Stage, not 14,000px down), Instrument level 2 mid-page (tightness headline, one supply sentence, a few face figures, one V3Chart), Quiet (about, three paragraphs then Read more), Ledger (daily life when library rows exist), Ledger (open houses: this neighborhood's keys, or heading Open houses across Bend), Ledger (subdivisions), V3PlacePropertyTypes, V3PlaceDocuments, V3PlaceCharacter, Ledger (guides), Quiet (FAQ heading is always Questions about {Neighborhood}, never the buyer/seller H2), Ledger (peers), Quiet (outbound edges), Ledger (other cities), Footer. SIX PATTERNS when a still exists — Stage, Field, Instrument, Ledger, Quiet, Sheet. No two adjacent share a pattern when every section renders; THE DEGRADED-STATE CONFLICTS ARE DECLARED, NOT HIDDEN. TWO SLUGS, TWO POPULATIONS (the metricNeighborhoodSlug convention): GIS, inventory, the map, and getPlaceCharacter key the prefixed boundary slug; documents and market figures key the METRIC slug. leftoverHudKpis grain 'neighborhood' is the one pile; pulse and cache never fill a tile; buildMarketFaq runs with source 'market-truth'; MoS is classified raw. Public titles and source lines do not print leftover, Market Truth leftover, leftover:true, leftover membership, or methodology v3.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + Neighborhood Place + Dataset + FAQPage JSON-LD. All four are emitted here: V3Breadcrumb and V3Quiet carry no structured data of their own, on purpose, so one derivation feeds the visible copy and the markup. Place.hasMap ships when NeighborhoodHomesField plots at least one pin.

requiredComponents.name: V3SectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Analytics island: section_view + scroll_depth on the one taxonomy (page_type derives from the path). Not a seventh pattern.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome, and the up-rung of the place ladder: Home > {City} > {Neighborhood}, current page never a link. tone=on-media when V3Stage opens on an owned still. Surface tone when there is no still and the Field opens the page.

requiredComponents.name: V3Stage
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 4, the opening when a place-owned still exists. Existing barrel Stage only: tokens.css + V3Stage.css, Imagine or geo-strict library photo as posterSrc, H1 is the money head term, action is the first house or #homes. No Unsplash, no Google map pixels, no street crop, no plat outline. No new hero system.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, once, level 2, MID-PAGE after Stage, Field, the email ask, and Latest market activity. Headline is 'How tight the market is' (or 'The {Neighborhood} market' when no verdict). Note is the one supply sentence. Figures are the few face cells (median list, detached homes for sale, months of supply, median to pending, sale to original list). One V3Chart (median close by month). Chart Room is not the first fold. The 30-tile stack is retired.

requiredComponents.name: NeighborhoodHomesField
requiredComponents.section: The route-local Field wrapper: H1 only when Stage did not take it + V3Field with PlaceFieldMap in the map slot + the listed-set source line. V3Field and PlaceFieldMap are imported by THIS component, not the route file, so this entry is the one the import gate binds on. Pattern 2: this neighborhood's houses as map plus list in one frame, under Stage when a still exists. 390 is list-first with a Map toggle (same as the city/home pass). Caption is the listed-set count plus the MoS verdict when the one derivation has one. Pins use --v3-cat. hasMap ships when at least one pin plots.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6. ABOUT is `{Neighborhood}, in plain words`: curated prose else the neighborhoods-table description, three paragraphs open then Read more (foldAfter=3). FAQ heading is always `Questions about {Neighborhood}` — the buyer/seller H2 is retired. Explore Quiet holds the outbound edges.

requiredComponents.name: NeighborhoodAlertsSheet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 5, once, in app/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug]/_v3/NeighborhoodAlertsSheet.client.tsx. The page's one on-page ask, after homes. Wraps V3Sheet and calls submitSearchAlertSignup with the same field name (email) and the same filters (city plus propertyType 'A', no subdivision key). The city scope is deliberate: neighborhood names are not 1:1 with MLS subdivision tags. Honeypot and standing disclosure stay intact.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. The canonical sitemap projection (V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS off lib/site-nav) plus the legal row. Footer titles are not H2. Cream background, 44px taps. Rendered OUTSIDE main.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3. Latest market activity sits under the Stage, not below the fold stack. Daily life (schools and parks) renders only when the library has school-* or park rows. Open houses use this neighborhood's listing keys, or the heading Open houses across Bend. Subdivisions, guides, peers, and other cities stay Ledgers.

requiredComponents.name: V3PlacePropertyTypes
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1 as ONE enumeration (2026-08-26 amendment): one Instrument per other property type this neighborhood holds, from getPublicPlaceSegments at neighborhood grain (metric slug).

requiredComponents.name: V3PlaceDocuments
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3: the recorded governing documents, keyed by the METRIC slug. Renders null when the place has none on file.

requiredComponents.name: V3PlaceCharacter
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6: build years + HOA measured from member listings (boundary slug). Renders null when nothing is publishable.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to KbNav today. Not in requiredComponents as itself because the gate checks the route file; the KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

deferredComponents.name: PlaceFieldMap on the route file
deferredComponents.reason: Lives inside NeighborhoodHomesField, same as CityHomesField on the city node. The route file does not import it.

removedComponents: KbHero (hero photo, neighborhood search field, and stat row) — replaced by V3Instrument level 1. The hero photo and its curated/regional-fallback resolution (communityImage, cityHero, mediaCaption) go with it: a photo is a Stage, and Stage is the pattern this page does not have. The H1 head term is preserved exactly: 'Homes for Sale' becomes the sentence-case 'homes for sale' the v3 register spells, and ci:seo-shell's contract for this route was moved in the same change to accept either register's spelling.
KbBreadcrumb overlay — replaced by V3Breadcrumb, surface tone, since there is no dark hero to sit on.

KbListingMap with its boundary polygon overlay, and PlaceMapListSplit — replaced by V3Field with PlaceFieldMap in the map slot. The polygon is still read (getGeoBoundaryMapData) because it is what makes the in-boundary count and the Place geo centroid honest, and it is drawn when the Field mounts the map. Place.hasMap returns with that map.
KbFeatured (poster grid of top-priced in-boundary listings) and resolveFeaturedItems — the same listings are the V3Field rows, price-descending, so the grid was a second rendering of one set.
KbTicker (scrolling price and address strip) — decoration, not a pattern.

KbMarketHud and KbMarketChart, and with them getPriceHistory for both the neighborhood and the parent-city fallback series, getRegionPulse (county median), and the chartScopeLabel machinery. The HUD's figures survive, split across the two Instruments by population. The 60-month median-close CHART does not: the barrel ships no chart primitive. The city-fallback rule it existed to make honest (a neighborhood series under 8 points or under 2 calendar years relabeled as the city's) is therefore moot on this route.

KbExploreTowns, twice (the subdivisions-in-this-neighborhood ledger and the other-cities ledger) — the subdivision and peer-neighborhood doors survive as links in the closing Quiet block; their per-row activeCount and medianPrice do not. getAllCitySnapshots goes with the other-cities ledger, replaced by one 'Every Central Oregon city' edge to /cities.
LifestyleNearSection with its lifestyleNearLatLng and mapCentroid reads — a lat-lng proximity rail with no pattern in the closed set.
KbAreaGuideVideo and getAreaGuideVideo — owned video is a Stage, and this page has no Stage.

KbOpenHouses and getOpenHousesWithListings — the read was CITY-scoped with an honest city eyebrow, so it was never neighborhood data. The open-houses door for the parent city survives in the closing Quiet block.

KbSell — a CTA block whose figures duplicated the Instrument's. The valuation ask survives as the Instrument's PRIMARY action. It was written down as surviving 'as the Instrument's ghost action and as the sticky header's filled primary', and the second half of that was false below 880px, where the header CTA computes display:none: between the deleted KbHero primary, the deleted KbHero ctaSecondary to /sell/valuation, and the deleted KbSell block, mobile was left with no filled seller CTA anywhere on the page.
KbArticles — the same three posts survive as links in the closing Quiet block; the thumbnails and excerpts do not.
KbTestimonials and KbTeam — brokerage trust blocks with no pattern in the closed set on a place node.
FAQBlock — the same buildMarketFaq array renders as V3Quiet prose and the FAQPage JSON-LD moved to MetadataBlock.

MarketSources — replaced by the Oregon Data Share edge in the closing Quiet block (same anchor text, same href) plus the per-section source lines, which name Oregon Data Share on every figure block INCLUDING the Field. That last clause was written before it was true: the Field's source line said only 'the recorded boundary polygon joined to the live listing index', naming no MLS, over the one block that renders individual listing records with street address, price, beds, baths and size. It now opens with the feed and with MarketSources' own explanatory clause ('the regional MLS cooperative behind every listing and market figure on this page'), so the attribution sits over the listing data rather than only thirty rows below it.
SmoothScrollProvider (Lenis smooth scroll) — PUBLIC_UI.md section 5 allows a scroll-bound sequence on exactly two moments and neither is here.

getMarketStatsCacheRowForGeo — a SECOND read of the same market_stats_cache row getMarketStats already returns, kept only for avg_sale_to_list_ratio, which getMarketStats projects as saleToListRatio. One row, one read.

getBlogPostsBySlugs for amenity topic-cluster links — verified 2026-08-12 that zero of the thirteen data/resort-community-bend-*.json configs carries a blog_slug, so the branch never fired on this route.

getCommunitiesInNeighborhood replaced by getCommunitiesInNeighborhoodLite — the heavy variant pulls up to 5,000 city tiles to compute a per-subdivision count and median, and this page no longer renders either figure. Reading them and dropping them is the discarded-read defect.

The post-submit 'Sign in to manage alerts' ANCHOR, from inside the Sheet — a terminal V3Sheet step carries prose, not links. The sentence naming the unsubscribe path survives in the terminal step, and the anchor itself survives on the page: same label, same href (/login?returnUrl=%2Faccount%2Fsaved-searches), in the closing Quiet block that carries this node's outbound edges. Nothing about this destination left the page.

The hero's in-boundary count as the page's headline inventory figure — the KB page published the raw listings_in_boundary pin count, which the RPC returns for EVERY active property type, under a hero that said single-family, so land, duplexes and condos were inside that number. The headline count now comes from the market_pulse_live row, which is the polygon narrowed to PropertyType A AND the Single Family Residence subtype, under the pulse's own trace and stamp, labelled 'single-family homes for sale'. The Field keeps the wider PropertyType A set, because hiding ten townhouses and four condominiums that are genuinely for sale inside the boundary would be a worse page than showing them, and it labels that set as what it is.

KbActivity - RESTORED 2026-08-12 as a V3Ledger, not deleted. The KB component stays off this route (the barrel law and the register ratchet both forbid re-importing it); getActivityFeedWithFallbackMulti, buildActivityItems and the in-boundary scoping are back in full.

KbMarketHud + PublicProductTypes + PublicPaceStats + PublicMixStats + NeighborhoodMarketCharts-as-markup - re-expressed, not dropped: the KPI row, pace items, and mix figures are the opening Instrument's figures off the same leftoverHudKpis pile; the property-type panel is the V3PlacePropertyTypes enumeration; the district chart room is neighborhoodMarketChartCards on the Instrument's cards slot. One market section per page (Matt 2026-07-29) holds because every chart rides inside the Instrument.

KbHero + publishNeighborhoodHero - the v3 opening is the Instrument (PUBLIC_UI §3), so there is no hero photo position for a stock image to land on. ci:publish-place-index-truth's neighborhood arm moved to the no-unvetted-hero form (2026-08-26).

PlaceMapListSplit's boundary polygon overlay - the Field's PlaceFieldMap plots the listed set's pins; the recorded polygon still drives the counted set and the schema centroid, but is not drawn. Reintroducing the overlay is a PlaceFieldMap prop, not a second map.

KbSell + publishSellMedian - the page publishes no sell median; the valuation door is the 'Value my home' edge in the closing Quiet, built by valuationHref so ?from= attribution survives. ci:publish-median-caption's neighborhood arm moved to the no-median-surface form on NeighborhoodAlertsSheet.
KbOpenHouses - the open-houses surface is /open-houses/[city]; the closing Quiet keeps the door.
KbAreaGuideVideo - the silent clip plays on the community node that owns it.
LifestyleNearSection - the explore-register lifestyle rail; daily life (schools, parks) is the locked first-path Ledger, and the parks door survives there.
KbTicker, KbTestimonials, KbTeam, MarketSources - retired with the register on this route: proof and team live on /about and /team; the ODS citation is an edge in the closing Quiet.
barrelGaps: V3Map as a barrel primitive is still open. This route's Field slot is filled by PlaceFieldMap (app/central-oregon/_v3/), shared with the other place-detail nodes. That closes the visitor-facing gap without putting a vendor map in the barrel.

A V3Quiet that can carry NAMED GROUPS of rows, or a rhythm-rule allowance for a second Quiet in one slot. The KB page filed this node's outbound graph under four distinctly-named blocks (KbExploreTowns twice, plus KbArticles). PUBLIC_UI.md section 3 caps a page at as many patterns as the content needs and forbids two adjacent sections sharing one, and this node spends its four on Instrument, Field, Sheet and Quiet, which leaves exactly two Quiet slots: one either side of the Sheet. ABOUT holds the first, so the FAQ and roughly thirty links share the second. The name now covers both halves, which is the honest fix available inside the locked language, but four ledgers collapsed to one section is a real loss of structure and it is this gap, not a preference, that caused it.

A hidden-field kind on V3Sheet was reported here as a gap and is now CLOSED: V3Sheet.trap renders the honeypot as a property of the surface rather than as one of its steps' questions, which is why the alert form's `company` defence works again.

required.emittedBy: MetadataBlock schemas array (breadcrumb entry). Items unchanged: Home, Cities, the city, the neighborhood.
MetadataBlock schemas array (place entry), placeType Neighborhood. hasMap is off while PlaceFieldMap is deferred. The DESCRIPTION is chosen by the branch that produced the figures (placeDescription).

MetadataBlock schemas array (dataset entry), variableMeasured and dateModified from the branch's own builder. Emitted only when there is at least one variable. Name, url, and spatialCoverage strings unchanged. THE DESCRIPTION IS NOW DERIVED FROM variableMeasured (datasetDescription) and names exactly the variables in the payload. It was a fixed sentence promising 'Live single-family home market data ... median list price, active inventory, and market statistics' beside whatever survived the per-figure guards — a machine-readable claim that could outrun its own payload, and that called the no-pulse branch's every-residential-type figures single-family. It now names no single population either, because the payload has none: months of supply divides an active count by a closed series and days-to-pending is measured on closed sales, so the sentence points the reader at the per-figure source lines on the page instead of picking one.
MetadataBlock schemas array (faqPage entry), items = the same faqs array V3Quiet renders. On the KB page this came out of FAQBlock's includeJsonLd; the payload's meaning is unchanged.

jsonLd.note: ONE DERIVATION PER BRANCH, AND EACH ONE NAMES THE POPULATION IT READ. The visible Q&A, the FAQPage items and the Dataset variables always come from one call, so the copy and the markup cannot diverge. On the pulse branch that call is buildMarketFaq, the shared builder that also owns the buyer's/seller's verdict. On the no-pulse branch it is fallbackFaqSet (_v3/neighborhood-claims.ts), because buildMarketFaq's prose is written for the single-family population and the KB page's habit of handing it getNeighborhoodBySlug's every-residential-type numbers published them as 'active single-family listings' in the visible rows, the FAQPage markup and the Dataset variables at once — on the one branch whose own on-page source line says that count is not the single-family subtype. The fallback pair names what it counted, publishes its count as 'Active Residential Listings' rather than 'Active Listings' so a machine is not told two different measures are the same one, carries no asOf stamp because that read carries none, and states no verdict because months of supply exists only on the pulse row.

dataLayer.getNeighborhoodBySlug: app/actions/cities.ts. Resolves the neighborhoods row and computes activeCount and medianPrice off listing_tile_mv for the neighborhood NAME, residential inventory types only. Feeds the metadata, the identity, the About fallback prose, and the level-1 Instrument's no-pulse branch.
dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts. market_pulse_live, geo_type neighborhood, geo_slug {citySlug}-{neighborhoodSlug}, property_type A. Verified live 2026-08-12: 28 neighborhood rows exist on that key. Written by refresh_community_market_pulse() (migration 20260727180000_bl016_community_pulse_and_yearly.sql), whose active_count reads listing_boundary_xref_mv filtered property_type='A' AND (property_sub_type IS NULL OR property_sub_type='Single Family Residence') over the SAME boundary the Field uses, whose median_days_to_pending reads closed sales from the last 90 days through the neighborhood_subdivisions alias join and is null below five, and whose months_of_supply divides the active count by that closed series over 180 days. Every one of those facts is stated in the level-1 source line, because a single sentence naming the active set could not cover all four. Feeds the level-1 Instrument, buildMarketFaq, AND generateMetadata: the meta description publishes a count, a SERP snippet carries no source line to reconcile one, and describing getNeighborhoodBySlug's every-residential-type number under the words 'single-family homes for sale' was false on every neighborhood and disagreed with the page's own H1 figure on the 28 that carry a pulse row. Same cache key and same window as the page's read, so it is one cached row rather than a second query per render.
dataLayer.getMarketStats: lib/data/market/getMarketStats.ts. market_stats_cache, geo_type neighborhood, the same city-qualified key, period_type rolling_365d. Verified live 2026-08-12: 74 rolling-365d rows per neighborhood on that key and none on the bare slug. Feeds the level-2 Instrument only.
dataLayer.getGeoBoundaryMapData: lib/data/geo/getGeoBoundaryMapData.ts. The recorded polygon plus in-polygon active pins via listings_in_boundary. Feeds the Field's listing-key set, its honest-count guard, and the Place geo centroid.
dataLayer.getListingTiles: lib/data/listings/getListingTiles.ts, by listingKeys from the boundary read, status active, propertyType A, limit 250. The RPC filters only StandardStatus, so this is where the PropertyType narrowing happens, and therefore where the count the Field publishes comes from. It is NOT a single-family narrowing: PropertyType A is a bucket holding single-family homes, townhouses and condominiums, which is why the Field's count and label say 'homes' and the level-1 count says 'single-family'. The tile's property_sub_type is projected onto every Field row for the same reason.
dataLayer.getCommunitiesInNeighborhoodLite: lib/data/communities/subdivisionFlags.ts. communities rows for this neighborhood_id, name and slug only. Feeds the subdivision doors.
dataLayer.peerNeighborhoodTowns: lib/explore/neighborhood-peers.ts over getBendNeighborhoodLedger. Feeds the sideways rung of the place ladder.
dataLayer.getResortCommunityContent: lib/resort-community-content.ts, keyed by the same city-qualified slug. Feeds the About block.
dataLayer.getRecentBlogPosts: lib/data/blog/getRecentBlogPosts.ts, cityName-weighted, limit 3. Feeds the guide doors.
dataLayer.note: ROUTE-LOCAL SHAPING IS TWO FILES. _v3/neighborhood-sections.ts turns rows into barrel props; _v3/neighborhood-claims.ts holds every SENTENCE the route publishes about a figure — the meta description, the Field's empty message and footnote, the no-pulse branch's Q&A, the Dataset and Place descriptions, and the four structured-data payloads themselves — under one rule: no claim may outrun its payload, so each function takes the payload it describes as its argument. Every read is a DAL function from @/lib/data or a route action (G8), and every one is still wrapped in withTimeoutFallback, which is a deadline and not a swallowed error: the underlying functions are resilient-cached and throw on a transient failure rather than caching a confident empty. NOTHING IS FETCHED THAT THIS PAGE DOES NOT RENDER; the seven reads the KB page made whose results are no longer displayed are listed in removedComponents. Route-local shaping lives in app/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug]/_v3/neighborhood-sections.ts so the route file stays under the ci:file-size-budget 600-line floor.
dataLayer.leftoverHud: lib/market/publish-leftover-hud.ts leftoverHudKpis({grain:'neighborhood', headlines/inventory: getDetachedOverlays keyed neighborhood:cityDetachedSlug(metricNeighborhoodSlug), pace:getPublicDetachedPace}). The ONE pile: hero count hud.active, median hud.medianList, published MoS hud.monthsSupply (sample-gated inside publishMonthsOfSupply). Miss omits; pulse and cache never fill.

sectionOrder: V3Stage (owned Imagine or library still + H1) when a place-owned poster exists
NeighborhoodHomesField (H1 only when Stage is absent + map plus list, caption is the listed-set count plus verdict)
NeighborhoodAlertsSheet (V3Sheet, city-scoped listing alert, after homes)
V3Ledger #activity (Latest market activity, under the Stage)
V3Instrument #market (level 2, tightness headline + one sentence + few figures + one chart) or V3Quiet (stated absence)
V3Quiet #about (in plain words, three paragraphs then Read more)
V3Ledger #daily-life (schools and parks, library rows only)
V3Ledger #open-houses (this neighborhood, or Open houses across Bend)
V3Quiet #faq (Questions about {Neighborhood}, never the buyer/seller H2)
